war_summary: On Day 131 of War 139, heavy frontline combat and frequent strategic base exchanges continue across several key sectors. The island and coastal theaters in Endless Shore, Oarbreaker, and Godcrofts exhibit the highest base turnover, recording numerous captures, neutralizations, and contested states over the past 2 to 6 hours around hotspots like Brackish Point, Grisly Refuge, and Argosa. On the mainland frontlines, Onyx, Clahstra, and Speaking Woods are absorbing massive casualty rates, with Onyx and Speaking Woods each sustaining over 3,000 casualties in the last two hours alone, while Clahstra has tilted to a 5-3 Warden advantage following continuous back-and-forth fighting around Transept and Bewailing Fort.
